_comment: Dependencies allowed by exception under P17 / ADR-0004. `categoryB` = weak-copyleft (LGPL/MPL/EPL); `undeclared` = the package.json carries no `license` field at all (pnpm reports "Unknown"), so a human read the licence file the package ships and recorded it here. Each entry is a deliberate, isolated, reviewed allowance — NOT a place to silence Cat-X (GPL/AGPL/source-available). `package` is matched by exact name OR name-prefix (covers per-platform variants). gate:licenses fails on any Cat-B or undeclared dep not listed here.

categoryB.reason: libvips native binary behind `sharp`. LGPL is weak copyleft; it is used unmodified and dynamically linked (a separate .dylib/.so loaded at runtime, never statically bundled into our JS), so it qualifies as FINOS/ASF Category B. It enters transitively via @huggingface/transformers' IMAGE pipeline; Vexa's mixed lane is AUDIO-only and never instantiates it.
categoryB.disposition: Logged exception AND pruned from the deployment artifact (`--no-optional` / omit @img/sharp-*), so no LGPL binary ships.

categoryB.reason: Native CSS transform/minification engine used by the Next/Tailwind toolchain. MPL applies to the unmodified dependency files, not to Vexa source or generated CSS.
categoryB.disposition: Logged exception; dependency remains an isolated build/runtime package managed by pnpm.
categoryB.scope: frontend build pipeline and Next CSS handling

undeclared.reason: Colour-manipulation library, a direct dependency of mermaid (diagram rendering in the terminal's doc/editor/chat renderers, Vexa-ai/vexa#1617). Its package.json omits the `license` field, so pnpm reports it as "Unknown"; the package itself ships `license` verbatim — "The MIT License (MIT), Copyright (c) 2019-present Fabio Spampinato, Andrew Maney" — and its repository (github:fabiospampinato/khroma) states MIT. Cat A on the text, undeclared only in the metadata.
undeclared.disposition: Logged exception; read from the shipped licence file at khroma@2.1.0. Re-read it if the package is ever upgraded across a major.
undeclared.scope: @vexa/terminal (transitive via mermaid, bundled into the client)
